correctness.rationale: The maximal-element/downset extension rule is proved exhaustive for all finite posets and exact directed isomorphism removes duplicates. Birkhoff gives a bijection to finite distributive lattices by join-irreducibles. Complete enumeration of all 19,449 types on 1 through 8 points yields exactly 19,448 distinct one-round degree profiles and the unique pair of 18-element lattices; independent combinations-based witness computation corroborates the profile, nonisomorphism (chain heights four/five), and separation at round two. No sampling extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: The ordered strict-lower/strict-upper degree histogram is the canonical first-round C2 refinement invariant of a poset. The exact sharp first failure and unique eighteen-element exceptional pair among 19,449 natural finite distributive lattice classes gives an interpretable finite-model-theoretic expressiveness boundary, with a proved second-round repair, beyond a routine tabulation of lattice counts. This does not assert an all-order theorem.
